name: use-html-theme
description: Themed-HTML toolkit, three pure skills sharing one context-triage preflight. use-html-theme: on any HTML-generation request, offer a catalog of visual themes (Birchline warm-editorial, Technical-minimal docs-site, High-contrast-dark dashboard), apply the chosen theme to all subsequent HTML in the session, and optionally persist it per-project — natural language and [theme: x] inline-flag control, side-by-side preview on request. html-codesign: interactive 'pick and export' decision pages — every question opens with a collapsible context-and-recommendation preamble (free-form rich content on a clarity scaffold), the reader answers, skips, or raises a question on each section, folds answered sections to dense summary rows for review, then exports the decision as Markdown/JSON (slim by default, full ADR-style by toggle) with stable IDs for diffable iteration. html-explain: read-only explainer pages for settled material — authoring maps which parts are intrinsically hardest and budgets the page around them, then enriches with diagrams, annotated figures, build-up sequences, and manipulable widgets ONLY where comprehension actually breaks; clarity canon (Mayer, Sweller, Minto, Heath, Tufte, Bertin, Cleveland) carried as advisory aids, with a standalone encoding fallback for surfaces where the bundled dataviz skill does not exist. Both page skills read recent context and ALWAYS confirm before generating — codesign for unanswered questions, explain for settled work — and hand off to each other when triage disagrees with the request. Both page skills close delivery the same way: the full absolute path on its own line, then conditional convenience offers — open it in the browser only when the session can reach one, add it to shelf only when that skill is installed, and where to save it whenever the file sits somewhere temporary or anywhere the agent chose rather than the user, read from context rather than a fixed ranking; copying the path to the clipboard is offered under the same gate as opening it. Portable across Claude Code and Codex.
